biome.hoenn_petalburg.name: Petalburg Woods (Hoenn)
biome.hoenn_petalburg.desc: Winding mossy woodland glades with sunlit forest trails and the Petalburg Moss Shrine.
biome.hoenn_chimney.name: Mt. Chimney Caldera (Hoenn)
biome.hoenn_chimney.desc: Volcanic ring caldera encircled by a molten lava moat, basalt bridges, and stepped ash cliffs.
biome.sinnoh_coronet.name: Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar (Sinnoh)
biome.sinnoh_coronet.desc: Stepped hexagonal alpine summit divided by a marble pilgrimage causeway under the stars.
biome.sinnoh_eterna.name: Eterna Twilight Woods (Sinnoh)
biome.sinnoh_eterna.desc: Misty twilight bog where five mossy ruin islands connect across dark canals toward the Old Chateau.
biome.unova_relic_desert.name: Relic Desert Resort (Unova)
biome.unova_relic_desert.desc: Wind-sculpted parallel desert dunes sweeping around a sunken sandstone Relic Courtyard.
biome.unova_dragonspiral.name: Dragonspiral Tower (Unova)
biome.unova_dragonspiral.desc: Grand spiral stone ramp winding around a moated ancient citadel in northern Unova.
biome.kalos_azure_bay.name: Azure Bay Coast (Kalos)
biome.kalos_azure_bay.desc: Sparkling turquoise island archipelago linked by curving white-sand tidal bars and coastal cliffs.
biome.kalos_reflection_cave.name: Reflection Crystal Cave (Kalos)
biome.kalos_reflection_cave.desc: Faceted geometric crystal terraces overlooking mirrored amethyst subterranean pools.
biome.alola_melemele.name: Melemele Tropical Shore (Alola)
biome.alola_melemele.desc: Crescent golden lagoon cove sweeping beneath terraced jungle bluffs and a Tapu totem.
biome.alola_wela_volcano.name: Wela Volcano Park (Alola)
biome.alola_wela_volcano.desc: Tiered red-rock fire trial terraces riven by glowing radial magma fissures.
biome.galar_wild_area.name: Galar Wild Area (Galar)
biome.galar_wild_area.desc: Expansive rolling highland moors bisected by a winding river valley and stone crossings.
biome.galar_crown_tundra.name: Crown Tundra Glacier (Galar)
biome.galar_crown_tundra.desc: Carved glacial ice-cliff fjord leading past frozen pools to the ancient Crown Shrine.
biome.paldea_asado_mesa.name: Asado Titan Mesa (Paldea)
biome.paldea_asado_mesa.desc: Stratified red-clay Monument buttes separated by dry sun-baked canyon arroyos.
biome.paldea_area_zero.name: Area Zero Great Crater (Paldea)
biome.paldea_area_zero.desc: Colossal inverted crystal crater stepping down toward Zero Lab along glowing Terastal ley-lines.
